importAccountWarning.source: After import, sign in with the factory account stored in this backup.

importOverwriteBody.source: The local service will stop and preserve a pre-import copy. Import is rejected while games or queues are active.

importOverwriteTitle.source: The current database will be overwritten

keepCurrentBody.source: The conflicting backup will be preserved in quarantine, then a new backup will be created from the current database.

leaderboardEmptyBody.source: Members appear here after a game completes and settles successfully.

leaderboardEmptyTitle.source: No settled points in this period

legacyRoomLiveScoreUnavailable.source: The legacy protocol does not report live scores or rankings

loginDescription.source: Enter an enabled operator account to continue.

loginFactoryHelp.source: If the factory administrator password is lost, contact the manufacturer for reinstall or factory recovery.

maintenanceOnlyBody.source: Log out and use the factory account to resolve the database backup conflict.

memberDeleteConsequences.source: The phone number can be registered as a new member with zero points. Old wristband and game history is retained.

memberDeleteDangerBody.source: For removing manual test members only. The phone number can be registered again after deletion, while old wristband and game history is retained.

memberDeleteModalDescription.source: This removes the active member profile.

memberExportNote.source: The export is an operational CSV for spreadsheet software, not a database backup for system recovery.

memberHistoryHistoricalNote.source: Recharge records are associated through this member's historical wristband bindings.

operatorAccountsDescription.source: Create and disable secondary store operator accounts. Accounts cannot be deleted.

prechargeInvalidMinutes.source: Enter a whole number of minutes between 1 and 1440

prechargeLoadFailed.source: Could not load precharges. Please retry.

wristbandFlowDescription.source: Charge at the counter first; the customer then finds or creates a member and binds the wristband at the kiosk. Timing starts on the first scan at a game terminal.
